name: Empagliflozin
description: A sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitor approved for type 2 diabetes, heart failure across the ejection-fraction range, and chronic kidney disease.

systems.note: Lowers glycaemia by increasing urinary glucose loss; the intended metabolic effect, placed on the pancreas as the glycaemic system.
Heart failure outcome reduction is a labelled indication in its own right.
Chronic kidney disease progression reduction is a labelled indication; the tubule is also the site of action.
Produces an expected early eGFR dip that reads as falling filtration but is haemodynamic, not injury.
Euglycaemic diabetic ketoacidosis is labelled and presents without marked hyperglycaemia.

monitors.why: The direct index of glycaemic effect.
Both the labelled renal indication and the expected initial haemodynamic dip.
The albuminuria endpoint the renal indication is built on.
Euglycaemic ketoacidosis is labelled and glucose will not signal it.
Volume and tubular effects move potassium.
